title: Companion mascot: remove white-square glare in dark mode

spec.problem: After WEB-434 themed companion surfaces, the collapsed companion mascot at bottom-right still renders as a bright near-white/light-gray rectangle in dark mode on every page. Direct Rive WASM draw inspection of 18912-35694-lil-guy.riv (Artboard 500x400) proves draw[0] paints an opaque #E0E0E0 full-artboard rectangle (rgba(224,224,224,1), bbox [2,2,502,402]) and draws[45..53] paint the three non-interactive #5BA5FF demo buttons at y=37..77 inside the binary .riv asset itself, while BattleBotAvatar variant=companion renders the canvas unclipped with no dark-mode presentation treatment. CompanionSpeechBubble also uses faint border-ink/8 and border-ink/10 borders in dark mode.

acceptance.text: AC1: Root cause stated with evidence (which layer paints the white/light-gray square and the three small blue buttons).
AC2: In dark mode the collapsed companion no longer renders as a white/near-white square (test asserting the dark-scoped classes/structure introduced; light-mode classes unchanged).

AC3: Mascot animation, tap-to-open, speech bubble, signal badge and chat panel behavior unchanged (existing companion/battle-bot tests pass; speech bubble dark-mode borders and AA text contrast verified).
AC4: pnpm quality verify passes; WEB-435 CLOSED via the harness; git status shows only intended files (no .build/, no tsbuildinfo).

spec.expected_behavior: In dark mode only, BattleBotAvatar variant=companion frames its inner canvas wrapper as a circular themed disc (dark:overflow-hidden dark:rounded-full dark:bg-surface dark:ring-1 dark:ring-border-hover dark:shadow-md), fills and softens the Rive canvas glare without distorting character hue (dark:scale-[1.26] dark:brightness-[0.80] dark:contrast-[1.06] dark:saturate-[1.12]), lifts the signal badge with dark:z-20, keeps rootSpan overflow-visible and light-mode/non-companion classes unchanged, and CompanionSpeechBubble adds dark:border-border on body and tail while maintaining >=4.5:1 AA text contrast.
spec.observed_behavior: In dark mode, BattleBotAvatar variant=companion leaves the 500x400 opaque #E0E0E0 Rive canvas unclipped and unattenuated over #0f172a paper (13.52:1 glare jump), producing a sharp-cornered light-gray rectangle; CompanionSpeechBubble renders border-ink/8 and tail border-ink/10 (1.57:1 vs dark paper) instead of theme border-border tokens.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the WEB-435 web-only changes in apps/web; no API, database, admin, deploy, or binary .riv asset files were modified.

classification.rationale: Presentation-only dark-mode styling fix for BattleBotAvatar companion variant and CompanionSpeechBubble border tokens in apps/web; no API, database, or domain logic changes.
